title: Music
learning_outcomes: Explain rhythm melody harmony in the context of music.
Compare and distinguish musical form in the context of music.
Apply cultural traditions in the context of music.
Evaluate and justify decisions about original composition in the context of music.

lessons.title: Rhythm melody harmony
lessons.outcome: Explain rhythm melody harmony in the context of music.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving rhythm melody harmony; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to listening and composition study.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain rhythm melody harmony from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of rhythm melody harmony; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Musical form
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish musical form in the context of music.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving musical form; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to listening and composition study.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain musical form from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of musical form; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Cultural traditions
lessons.outcome: Apply cultural traditions in the context of music.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving cultural traditions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to listening and composition study.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain cultural traditions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of cultural traditions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Original composition
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about original composition in the context of music.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving original composition; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to listening and composition study.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain original composition from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of original composition; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of rhythm melody harmony; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of musical form; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of cultural traditions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of original composition; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practising artist or arts educator; cultural expertise where relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
